title: FAU Graduation Scholarship for International Students

provider.name: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU) / German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) / Free State of Bavaria

summary: Final semester scholarship supporting international Master's and State Examination students at FAU during graduation with a one-time 1000 EUR payment.

degree_levels.notes: Open to students in Master's and State Examination degree programs. Excluded: Bachelor's degree programmes and one-year orientation, pre-master, or postgraduate programmes.

subject_areas.notes: No complete subject list is stated. Eligibility is specifically limited to eligible Master's and State Examination students at FAU.

institutions.notes: Must be actively enrolled at FAU.

nationality.notes: Only international students without German citizenship or permanent residence may apply. This is additional to the degree, enrolment and financial-need conditions.

residence.notes: Continuous residence in Germany for the duration of the coming semester is required; scholarship is not intended for funding stays abroad.

mandatory.text: International student without German citizenship or permanent residence
Master's or State Examination degree program
FAU graduation planned by end of March 2027
Good or very good grades (current GPA between 1,0 and 2,3)
Minimum 75 ECTS visible in transcript of records
German language proficiency at least at basic level
Continuous residence in Germany for the duration of the coming semester
Complete online application and upload required documents
Reference letter from a full FAU professor using the template, sent via FAU e-mail account to peter.forna@fau.de

preferences.text: Students with low income will be given priority
Students who hold the nationality of a country on the United Nations list of Least Developed Countries (LDCs) are given special consideration
Students with extracurricular involvement are given special consideration

funding.description: Amounting to 1000 EUR in total, paid out to successful applicants in one transaction.

application_rounds.notes: Application deadline for the Graduation Scholarship for Winter Semester 2026/27 is 28 October 2026 at 12:00 noon. Source deadline clock time: 12:00; timezone needs confirmation.

required_documents.text: Up-to-date transcript of records from FAUcampo
Reference letter from a full FAU professor (using the provided template, sent as a PDF from the professor's personal FAU e-mail account)

steps.text: Fill out the online application form and submit it
Receive e-mail after successful submission containing a confirmation link
Perform additional formalities within the platform (upload documents, etc.)
Ensure the professor's recommendation letter is sent directly by e-mail before the deadline

sources.title: Scholarships for international students about to graduate | FAU
sources.notes: International students physically studying in Germany at FAU in Master's or State Examination degree programs can receive funding for completing their studies.
